actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident3 gave >30 units in the last round, so we punish them with the maximum severity affordable (floor(39.04/0.3)=130) and broadcast a reminder to keep contributions low.

So we must punish that resident with max severity we can afford: severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Wallet = 39.04, cost 0.3 => floor(39.04/0.3)= floor(130.133)=130 severity. Can we punish Resident3? Yes target not self. So action punish Resident3 amount 130. Also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. So actions list two: punish and broadcast.
